purpose: Test whether the frozen round-12 online-RL Flow supplies useful starts for the established Flow-latent Adam200 recipe.

frozen_flow.immutability: The numbered checkpoint was atomically written and is selected by exact SHA-256; the live RL job is neither changed nor stopped.

optimization.direction_policy: fresh random orthogonal centered directions per update
optimization.flow_decode: FP32 RK4-128 with pipelined accepted-center and next-gradient endpoint decoding
optimization.axis_policy: global screening axis is reused as a strict optimizer step-0 hint; maximum score difference is 0.1
optimization.evaluator: ABI-11 axis-circulation and cubic-iota native score

sample_plan.parallelism: Two independent one-GPU Students workers run concurrently; each GPU executes its four trajectories sequentially.

comparison_scope: Optimizer mechanics match qh-flow-screen32-adam200-64d-abi11-v1. The frozen Flow checkpoint and fixed nfp=8,nc=3 condition identify this as a separate experiment.
default_impact: none; qh-flow-screen32-adam200-64d-abi11-v1 remains the current default
